note: A screen, not an audit: questions worth asking and the data needed to answer them. No savings are computed; typical benefits are the cited sources' general wording.

questions.question: What records support this refrigeration compressor's part-load control, sequencing and real-input basis?

evidence.text: equipment K-A reads "K-A Ammonia R-717 screw compressor A"
final element SC-A reads "SC-A VFD candidate, enabled/mode/history unknown" at K-A
SC-A enabled = "unknown"; blank; meaning and suitability unverified
SC-A source_revision = "draft-A"; present; meaning and suitability unverified

data_requests.item: Capacity-control mode and representative load for this compressor
where: DCS/PLC configuration: existing identified compressor configuration and active/fallback mode, slide-valve or bypass function, revision and responsible owner
site records: permitted load/capacity histories with machine identity, period and coincident suction/demand conditions
data_requests.how: Retain labels and enabled/disabled/unknown qualifiers as candidates. Establish actual function and a representative operating basis; a nameplate or drive label does not establish part-load behavior.

data_requests.item: Representative real input power on the same operating basis
where: site records: approved existing electrical-input and run/load observations with quantity, units, time and conversion basis
the vendor datasheet: applicable compressor/drive limits and part-load performance basis
data_requests.how: Compare suitable coincident input and load records. Separate ratings, electrical indications and near-full-load conditions from actual representative real input; request missing evidence without inventing a value or authorizing measurements.

data_requests.item: Actual sequencing, served group and applicable supplier constraints
where: DCS/PLC configuration: existing reviewed sequence/trim logic, machine-to-suction-group association, active overrides and revision
site records: permitted operating/event records showing which machines actually trim under comparable conditions
the vendor datasheet: applicable supplier constraints and responsible engineering review route
data_requests.how: A sequencer label alone does not establish active operation or complete group coverage. Return a qualified partial answer or missing-evidence request to the responsible reviewer.

questions.decision_rule: Investigate missing or conflicting source/function/operating evidence for each named machine. A drive or sequencing label does not settle efficiency, and the source describes load-dependent tradeoffs. Close only the source investigation after qualified evidence review; no drive change, operating instruction or savings estimate follows.

typical_benefit.wording: Among control strategies that "may compromise system energy efficiency" (S25, p. 59, citing Pearson 2003): "Slide valve unloading of oversized screw compressors." and "Hot gas bypass of compressors." Speed control (S25, p. 63): "ASDs used on compressors below a part-load ratio of about 95% will deliver performance equal to a fixed speed compressor but with lower electricity requirements. However, at near full (i.e., 100%) load, ASDs are approximately 3% less efficient than fixed speed drives".
source_titles: S25: Brush, Masanet and Worrell, Energy Efficiency Improvement and Cost Saving Opportunities for the Dairy Processing Industry: An ENERGY STAR Guide for Energy and Plant Managers (LBNL-6261E, Oct 2011)

questions.limits: This is an authored per-machine collection policy informed by S25 printed pp.59,62,63, not a quoted design requirement or installed-state diagnosis. Labels and literal facts remain unverified candidates; review actual association, operating conditions and supplier constraints. No fixed observation duration or operating limit is inferred. A drive or sequencing change goes through the compressor vendor (minimum speed, oil management, vibration). Fires only where the equipment's own name, type or service names the refrigerant (ammonia, NH3, R-717, a refrigerant number) or says refrigeration; an air compressor, a process recycle compressor, a process condenser on cooling water or a power-plant air-cooled condenser does not.
